lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 7 distinct vertical lines visible across the lateral torso mass. Spacing is irregular, with the widest intervals occurring between the 3rd and 4th lines, and narrower intervals toward the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st anterior line (shoulder) and the 7th posterior line (flank) are abbreviated, terminating above the ventral midline. The 5th line displays a mid-section pixel fade/discontinuity.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast circular white spots is positioned on the posterior flank, superior to the hind leg joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of 3 spots is visible within the posterior cluster, forming a semi-linear geometric pattern across the upper haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate silhouette with primary vectors extending posteriorly from the skull base, then curving medially and upward toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 3:1 ratio of the horizontal pixel distance between the terminal tips relative to the pixel width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Light-colored ivory terminal tips occupy approximately 12% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron mark between the eyes; singular white spots on the cheek and bridge of the muzzle; distinct white and black banding on the lower forelimbs.
